chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa al-Daqqaq (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariyya al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Habib narrated to us. He said: Umar ibn Abdullah narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn ibn Asim narrated to us. He said: Isa ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (peace be upon him). He said: Salman the Good (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to me, saying:

O Aba al-Hasan! Rarely do you come while I am in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) except that he says: "O Salman! This one and his party are the triumphant on the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.المفلحون: The triumphant/successful ones, those who attain ultimate salvation
key_terms.حزبه: His party/followers, referring to the supporters and devotees of Ali (AS)
key_terms.يوم القيامة: The Day of Resurrection, the final day of reckoning

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali and his followers on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: Salman al-Farsi relates to Imam Ali (AS) that almost every time Ali appeared before the Prophet (SAWW) while Salman was present, the Prophet would declare Ali and his followers to be the triumphant on the Day of Resurrection. This hadith, narrated in a teaching assembly in 368 AH, echoes the Quranic concept from Surah al-Mujadila (58:22) about the 'party of God' and was understood by its audience as affirming Ali's spiritual authority.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
